# stackit_identity_group (Resource)

Manages a STACKIT Identity Group in an organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "stackit_identity_group" "group" {
  organization_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  display_name    = "group-01"
  description     = "This is an example identity group."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the group.
- `organization_id` (String) STACKIT Organization ID to which the group is associated.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the group.

### Read-Only

- `group_id` (String) The internal UUID of the group.
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID, structured as "`organization_id`,`group_id`".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [` + "`" + `import` + "`" + ` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the ` + "`" + `id` + "`" + ` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Only use the import statement if you want to import an existing Identity Group
import {
  to = stackit_identity_group.import-example
  id = "${var.organization_id},${var.group_id}"
}
```
